name: Park Hyatt Shenzhen
positioning: High-floor city hotel in Shenzhen's Futian business district, with Yabu Pushelberg-designed guestrooms and skyline dining
best_for: Travelers who want a base in the Futian business district
Guests who want high-floor skyline dining and a bar at the top of the hotel

facts.text: Park Hyatt Shenzhen is in the Futian business district of Shenzhen.
Guestrooms are on floors 36 through 44 and have floor-to-ceiling windows.
Guestrooms have a dressing zone separated by French sliding doors, a separate bathtub and rain shower, and a powder room with an automatic washlet.
Each room has a Nespresso coffee machine.
In the evening a live DJ plays in the Living Room.
The Attic has a private KTV room for parties and celebrations.
Pool Terrace offers alfresco barbecue dining and cocktails on Level 8, next to the swimming pool.
The fitness center overlooks the indoor pool and has a steam room.
Signature treatments at The Spa include restorative massages aimed at deep stress and muscular tension.
Nearby places to explore include Lianhuashan Park and Shenzhen Bay Park.
Self-parking is complimentary for hotel guests.

highlights.text: The Glasshouse restaurant is on the 47th floor under a glass ceiling, with 270-degree views of the Shenzhen skyline.
The guestrooms were designed by Yabu Pushelberg, with custom-made furniture and art.
The Attic bar is at the top of the hotel and has an extensive collection of premium gins.
The Presidential Suite has its own private spa treatment room.
The Sky View Deluxe corner rooms look out over the Shenzhen landscape and the bay.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in mainland China.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may lack resort-style outdoor spaces.
